newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Adamjee Insurance up 1.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Adamjee Insurance up 1.75 pct.

text.p: Pakistan's Adamjee Insurance Co 10-rupee stock rose two rupees, or 1.75 percent, to 116.00 on Tuesday.
Dealers linked the buying to the closing of Adamjee's books on June 17 for entitlement to a 20 percent final cash dividend and 25 percent bonus shares, dealers said.
Adamjee paid a 15 percent interim cash dividend for the year ended December 1996 for a total 35 percent cash dividend and 25 percent bonus stocks for 1996.
Some 4,000 shares changed hands in the morning session.
Adamjee will close its books from June 17 to July 1.
